cohort: 1004 healthy women who gave birth to a single, live neonate
finding: The Hindi versions of the Turkish Scale for Measuring Maternal Satisfaction: Normal and Caesarean Births were found to be valid and reliable tools for measuring maternal satisfaction with childbirth services in India.
mod_finding: Separate versions of the scale, one for vaginal deliveries and one for cesarean deliveries, were found to be valid and reliable.
